verdict.rationale: Interview scheduling is a fair axis for an ATS like Workable, but the evidence pack never documents automated panel or onsite-loop scheduling, interviewer load balancing, room booking, or conflict resolution. The events endpoint only returns a collection of events and does not show any automated scheduling capability.

support.subject: As a recruiter, multi-interviewer panels and full onsite loops schedule automatically — interviewer load balancing, room booking, and conflict resolution included
